Implementation must also be accompanied by adequate advisor training and resource allocation; simply having the model isn’t enough – it needs skilled interpretation and responsive support.

A3.justification: While I appreciate the compromises reached and the focus on fairness, I remain concerned about over-reliance on predictive modelling itself.
